# Third-party source

`stb_truetype.h` is stb_truetype 1.26 from the official
[`nothings/stb`](https://github.com/nothings/stb) repository, pinned at commit
`2c980bb59875b0d32144a71867fbdebb2f77cd20`.

It is intentionally kept in upstream form and is excluded from Native's local
C++ formatting and file-length conventions. Its dual public-domain/MIT terms
are reproduced in `STB-LICENSE.txt` and at the end of the header.
